messages:
maria: Quick UX pass on the API Keys page — a few small but important nits around the create/rotate/revoke flows and the empty state. Posting screenshots + thoughts.
will: thanks — can you enumerate the nit list so we can triage?
maria: sure. high level: (1) rotate modal copy is alarmist, no clear undo language; (2) revoke action is buried in a kebab with no keyboard affordance; (3) empty state CTA is low contrast and unclear about scopes; (4) permission dropdown shows full role names which overflow on small widths.
aj: for (1) i think we should change the rotate modal title from `Rotate key` to `Rotate key (recommended)` and add a short line: `If you rotate, old tokens will stop working immediately. You can paste the new token now to update integrations.` also suggest an inline `Undo` in toast for 30s.
will: +1 on undo toast. also keyboard focus: when the rotate modal opens focus should go to the primary button, not the close X.
sam: on revoke: can we add a two-step confirm inline? e.g. click revoke -> small inline prompt `Type REVOKE to confirm` for non-admin roles. For admins maybe show a checkbox `I understand this will invalidate tokens.` prevents accidental clicks.
liz: empty state: current copy `Create an API key` button is visually subtle and sits far from the explanatory copy. Suggest we surface example scopes (read: embeddings, write: routes) and a short code snippet to show usage. Also change CTA color to primary.
maria: accessibility bits: role dropdown needs `aria-label`, and the kebab menu items aren't reachable with `Enter` on keyboard — seems like menu library lost default behavior. Also contrast for the muted helper text is 3.5:1 on our test — below recommended 4.5:1.
aj: agree on contrast. Proposed rotate modal copy (draft):
```
Title: Rotate key
Body: Rotating creates a new key and immediately disables the old one. Update your services with the new key now. We'll show the new key once; store it securely.
Buttons: [Copy & Close] [Show new key] [Cancel]
Toast (after rotate): Key rotated — old key invalidated. Undo? [Undo] (30s)
```
will: minor: the `Copy & Close` label is confusing — what does close do vs `Show new key`? maybe `Reveal key` and `Done` is clearer.
aj: good point. revise: `[Reveal key] [Done]` and a small subcopy under Reveal: `This will display the token once.`
design-bot: Accessibility checklist suggestion: 
- Ensure modal title uses h2 semantics
- Focus trap and initial focus on primary action
- Kebab menu items have role=menuitem and keyboard handlers
- Buttons use explicit aria-labels for icons (e.g., `aria-label="more actions for API key alpha"`)
- Empty state helper text >= 4.5:1 contrast

maria: also caught a layout regression on narrow widths: key row wraps and the action menu covers the key value. Maybe collapse the key preview to a copy icon on small screens.
sam: for permissions granularity: current roles are `Owner | Admin | Read` — customers ask for scoped perms like `Embeddings:read, Routes:write`. Maybe show a `Scopes` pill list in the create flow and example presets.
liz: UX for presets: dropdown `Preset: minimal, app-server, admin` and display pill chips that are editable. Default empty state can show `Preset: minimal` selected with sample chips.
maria: would someone from eng take the keyboard/menu fix? it's a small lib change but blocks accessibility audit. @will can you own?
will: I can take the kebab focus and menu role fix this sprint. filing a tiny ticket now.
will: ticket: https://issues.internal/RED-8213 (added checklist + a11y test steps)
aj: i'll sprint on the rotate modal copy + toast UX. I'll attach copy variations to the ticket.
maria: thanks. can someone also update the empty state mock with the preset chips + example snippet? @liz?
liz: on it. I'll drop an updated Figma file later today and ping here. :paintbrush:
maria: awesome. leaving design acceptance criteria here so we don't lose it:
- rotate modal copy + undo toast
- reveal/done button labels clarified
- menu keyboard + aria fixes
- empty state CTA prominence + presets + contrast fix
- revoke: type-to-confirm for non-admins, checkbox for admins

will: noted. i'll add testcases to the ticket.
sam: can we add a quick labelling tweak for the keys list: `Last used` column should be `Last used (app)` to clarify it's token usage not console login. small wording but reduces support tickets.
maria: good call. add that to the ticket too.
will: assigning this to `eng-product-a11y` epic. thanks everyone. :+1:
